item.title: Big Red BBQ at Reunion and Homecoming (Registration Required)
item.description: Date: Saturday, October 10, 2026 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM - Calling all students! The Office of Alumni Engagement invites you to join RPI alumni at this year’s signature Reunion and Homecoming event. Enjoy great food, a live band, and fun games while connecting with alumni from across the generations. If you have a campus meal plan, you’ll use your meal swipe on site. Don’t have a meal plan? No problem — you’re still invited to enjoy the BBQ! Pre-registration is REQUIRED.

item.title: Upcoming Student SIS Maintenance
item.description: The Student Information System (SIS) will be unavailable for any student registration adjustments from September 30th at 10 PM through October 1st at 11 AM. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

item.title: Sophomore Saturday with our Learning Assistants!
item.description: Join our Learning Assistants on Saturday, October 3rd from 4-7PM to decorate your own tote bag with fabric markers and bedazzling! This is a great time to ask our LA’s any question and feel recognized as your sophomore year continues! We would love to see you join us in Blitman Residence Commons!

item.title: Opening of Meta Mondrian on September 30
item.description: Can microbes paint inside the line? or can we learn about early earth photosynthesis by growing microbes under different light conditions? COME FIND OUT! September 30 from 4-6pm to celebrate the opening (and evolution) of Meta Mondrian installed at Early Earth Laboratory BW01 Jonsson Rowland Science Center Rensselaer Astrobiology Research and Education (RARE) Center, Troy, NY.

item.title: Division of Human Resources: Supervisory Essentials
item.description:
Rensselaer’s Managers and Supervisors play a pivotal role in the success of the Institute. More than any other factor, the relationships that they forge with employee direct reports and colleagues contribute to defining the levels of engagement and job satisfaction that our employees feel. These Managers and Supervisors are the fulcrum of the Employee Value Proposition, carefully balancing the needs of the individual and the organization.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
